rules.statement: The register of temple lands prepared under the provisions of 'The Temple Lands Registration Ordinance, 1856,' is binding on the Crown in all questions touching the boundaries and extents of the several lands claimed by the temple concerned.
rules.supporting_quote: "A register of temple lands prepared under the provisions of " The Temple Lands Registration Ordinance, 1856, " is binding on the Crown in ail questions touching the boundaries and extents of the several lands claimed by the temple concerned"
